items.title: Brock Purdy: Maximizes completions in Week 3 win
items.description:
Purdy completed 15 of 27 passes for 297 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for 34 yards in the 49ers' 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Juwan Johnson: Finds end zone twice in Week 3 loss
items.description:
Johnson caught all eight of his targets for 53 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders.

items.title: Trey McBride: Busy as usual in Week 3 loss
items.description:
McBride brought in nine of 11 targets for 75 yards in the Cardinals' 36-30 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Gets nine targets in Week 3
items.description:
Egbuka recorded five catches (on nine targets) for 62 yards during Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Thrives in workhorse role Sunday
items.description:
Love rushed 21 times for 90 yards and brought in all five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals' 36-30 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
